basis:
Reviewed the entire original public b19074d3022694b6180f115c875f9883c1ac9425..375cc084e27e07846041bd9f8cf8126ab5ac2b65 integration (49 changed paths), AGENTS/task/standards/envelope, Rust storage/protocol/workload adapters, independent raw oracles, collector/controller/codegen/CI/metadata/ZIP paths and the three packet-hashed external root helpers. Read-only source fingerprint independently matches head/tree/digest and clean state. Two independently reproduced P2 oracle/provenance false acceptances block this candidate; these replays do not demonstrate the original Rust execution applied early or exceeded caps.
The design-only CAS P2 is substantively repaired: eight sequential rounds, four admitted contenders sharing each freshly read ETag, distinct round/generation/contender bodies, joining before independent GET resolution, global four-request ceiling and separate bounded known-conflict retry. Actual complete object raw replay corroborates eight winners/twenty-four conflicts; focused schedule/CAS red controls remain. No formal prior finding keys exist; resolutions is intentionally empty.
Independently ran all 78 focused Python durability tests (7.391s, all pass). Reopened the original complete public local x64 matrix (12 fresh samples, 40 contexts each, 144 object cases) through the frozen helper, including its actual state/wire/operation/count oracles and seven unsafe-copy controls per sample. A second complete replay of an owned copy confirms the object provenance false acceptance. A separate actual-context mutation and rebundled complete 40-context raft-rs sample confirm early-apply false acceptance while all seven existing unsafe-copy controls still pass. Original source/evidence remains unchanged; no workload rerun or store mutation.
Independently matched complete-suite/coverage raw log hashes, 389 Python/no skips, two 42-test ordinary Rust summaries, 11 compiler controls and preserved strict engine framing. Rechecked immutable production/compiler/coverage-policy Git objects and the inventoried testkit-only dev manifest/161-package lock delta against public b190. Coverage summary/source/context receipts report both 523/523, engine/changed N/A with unchanged production; no independent Rust/coverage collection or merge was executed in this review. Narrow changed-blob secret/private-host signature scan found no hits; dependency/source/license inventory and audited pinned codegen scope were inspected, without granting a project license or proving reproducible upstream binaries.
Normal-entry Ready coalescing stages a private map and publishes applied events/messages/advance only after actual file and directory sync in the delivered Rust path; configuration-changing and LightReady application retain separate paths. This source inspection does not cure the independent temporal-oracle gap. Exact request/response/body versus logical payload, KMS-model versus actual-zero and physical quorum versus policy lanes remain distinguished. Failed source/deadline/parser/lint/formatter/oversized histories are retained as nonqualifying. Hosted x64/ARM/official nine-job raw CI, protected merge/postmerge and actual ARM codegen remain pending; no runtime, real power-loss, provider/fleet, crypto/format, license, release/deployment or M01.09-cause/M01.08 closure is accepted. This is formal R1/overall2; existing design history and hard3 budget are preserved.

findings.reproduction: External helper is P-root D:\codex\2026-11-01\task\verify_m02_durability_public.py (packet SHA 1d537157e36507481bcb55d00d220d25b2ed05512402ca7899e9dbbb4982c5ed). Run the task-owned M02.10_R1_CORRECTNESS_PUBLIC_BINDING_REPLAY.py against the retained M02.10_LOCAL_MATRIX_V2 data. It first invokes actual verify_components on the original, then copies that public tree and changes only the object's raw run_started record: source/fixture/envelope hashes to zero, architecture to aarch64, uid to 0 and all cgroups to unlimited. It recalculates that copied extent's bytes/hash and object_result.artifacts descriptor, retaining the original claimed outer source/target/verification. Both full 12-native/144-object replays return pass. Receipt M02.10_R1_CORRECTNESS_PUBLIC_BINDING_REPLAY.json; elapsed217.985s. Direct verify_events also passes with run_started removed entirely (separate OBJECT_BINDING_REPLAY receipt). Original evidence and source are unchanged.
findings.expected: Independently require exactly one complete object raw execution receipt and bind its run/namespace, source/fixture/envelope, native target, uid and finite CPU/memory/swap/PID limits to the expected source and actual object summary/engine/worker evidence, failing on omission or contradiction before complete_public_durability_raw=pass. Retain equivalent negative controls through the public helper, including the official-job path.
findings.observed: The object branch checks outer result.source/image and monitors, then calls an oracle that ignores run_started. Unlike the native branch, it never verifies actual raw object source/target/kernel identity or the corresponding summary/engine proof. A current claimed wrapper can therefore qualify raw object evidence explicitly declaring a different source/architecture and unlimited root execution.

findings.reproduction: Run task-owned M02.10_R1_CORRECTNESS_EARLY_APPLY_REPLAY.py and M02.10_R1_CORRECTNESS_EARLY_APPLY_SAMPLE.py. In actual raft-rs run3ce03ac0e15bf717e0e23062, sparse/seed7/wait50000 workload, move leader applied(index2, sparse-7-000) from sequence270 immediately before the first serialized transmission of that operation to any follower (original sequence223, source1->target2). Reindex event sequences and set the moved timestamp to its preceding event; recount only artifact metadata/hashes. Existing wire bytes, final voter files, all operations and sample counts remain unchanged. Native workload verify_case and order_events both accept. Repacking that changed context into the original complete40-context sample also yields native_complete_sample=pass,18workloads, all7unsafe controls passing. Exact receipts are the paired EARLY_APPLY_REPLAY.json and EARLY_APPLY_SAMPLE.json under P; no native workload/source edit.
findings.expected: Every applied index/identity must have independent, temporally prior evidence of the required committed/durably backed prefix and synced application state, including matched workloads, before the raw complete sample can qualify. The actual early-application mutation must fail while legitimate normal-entry atomic Ready staging, deferred configuration changes and LightReady ordering remain accepted without lowering bounds or assertions.
findings.observed: The applied branch only requires an existing sync generation (and a newer generation if a Ready is active); it does not establish that this applied index/identity was committed or present in that transaction. Workload checks later require contiguous indices, final files and final acknowledgments, which cannot detect this earlier violation. The independent full sample accepts a declared application before the entry was sent to either follower. This is an oracle false acceptance, not an observed early-apply defect in the current Rust adapter.
